findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.trooth.co" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trooth_profile_validate, trooth_verify, semanto_review_get · Private data: trooth_ask, trooth_company_changes, trooth_get_fact, trooth_list_companies, trooth_my_company_record, trooth_outside_in_read, trooth_profile_domain_check, trooth_profile_domain_start, trooth_public_trust_profile, trooth_resolve_company, trooth_search_companies, trooth_verify · Public sink: trooth_hub_sync, trooth_profile_domain_check, trooth_profile_domain_start, trooth_profile_get, trooth_profile_publish, trooth_profile_remediation_plan, trooth_profile_validate, trooth_public_trust_profile, semanto_status, semanto_setup_read_again, semanto_setup_choose, semanto_review_get, semanto_setup_confirm, semanto_sign, semanto_pages_changed, semanto_install_guide, semanto_install_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trooth_profile_validate, trooth_verify, semanto_review_get · Private data: trooth_ask, trooth_company_changes, trooth_get_fact, trooth_list_companies, trooth_my_company_record, trooth_outside_in_read, trooth_profile_domain_check, trooth_profile_domain_start, trooth_public_trust_profile, trooth_resolve_company, trooth_search_companies, trooth_verify · Public sink: trooth_hub_sync, trooth_profile_domain_check, trooth_profile_domain_start, trooth_profile_get, trooth_profile_publish, trooth_profile_remediation_plan, trooth_profile_validate, trooth_public_trust_profile, semanto_status, semanto_setup_read_again, semanto_setup_choose, semanto_review_get, semanto_setup_confirm, semanto_sign, semanto_pages_changed, semanto_install_guide, semanto_install_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
